# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Tuesday, November 10, 2026

Morning edition for Tuesday, 10 November 2026 (IST). Covers Monday 9 Nov and overnight. Today is a trading holiday on NSE and BSE (Diwali-Balipratipada), so the closes below are Monday's.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Blackstone set to take 15% of IIFL Finance for about ₹5,000 crore
ET reports that Blackstone will invest around ₹5,000 crore for 15% of IIFL Finance, with promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman adding ₹1,200 crore, taking the total infusion to a little over ₹6,200 crore. ET says the money would lift IIFL's capital adequacy by about 5 percentage points to 28% and could cut its borrowing costs by 100–150 bps through a better rating; Moneycontrol reported the board meets on 10 Nov to weigh the proposals.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: IIFL Finance is a listed gold-loan competitor, and a better-capitalised IIFL with lower funding costs could compete more strongly on gold-loan pricing; the deal is also a fresh private-equity valuation reference for gold-focused NBFCs ahead of Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/blackstone-set-to-acquire-15-of-iifl-for-rs-5000-crore/articleshow/135691311.cms)

### CII asks the Finance Ministry to review the 100% risk weight on secured gold loans
CNBC-TV18 reports that CII's reform agenda asks for a review of the 100% risk weight on secured gold loans, easier ECB conditions for NBFCs, and more access to long-term money from HNIs, pension funds and insurers. It also asks the government to look at the tax gap between banks and NBFCs.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: this is an industry proposal, not a rule change; a lower risk weight on gold loans, if adopted, would reduce the capital held against gold-loan books such as Muthoot Fincorp's.
Source: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/economy/cii-recommends-regulatory-relaxations-nbfcs-reform-agenda-to-finance-ministry20030393-20030393.htm)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
| Field | Value | As of |
|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; Chittorgarh's allotment page still says allotment status is not available; today is a market holiday, so no listing today ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/ncd_allotment_status/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)) | 2026-11-10 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe); final allotment size not yet published | 2026-11-10 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-10 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-10 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov; BSE shows 53,36,597 NCDs bid against 20,00,000 base (266.83%) ([BSE](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-05 |

### Update: no allotment notice yet for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs, and today's exchange holiday rules out a 10 Nov listing
NSE's holiday list confirms 10 Nov as a trading holiday, so the listing date carried earlier can't hold. Chittorgarh's allotment page this morning still says allotment status isn't available, and no revised listing date has been published.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the deemed date of allotment and a revised listing date are still awaited; the company's listed-debt Q2 results fall due by 14 Nov.
Source: [Chittorgarh allotment page](https://www.chittorgarh.com/ncd_allotment_status/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)

### Muthoot Microfin flat on Monday at ₹159.73
Muthoot Fincorp's microfinance subsidiary closed at ₹159.73 on NSE on 9 Nov, up ₹0.06 from the Muhurat close, holding Sunday's 3.74% gain. It traded 3,59,779 shares.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the listed subsidiary held its Muhurat-session gain in a full session.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy 9 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_09112026.csv)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Muthoot Finance up 2.19% as gold rebounds; FinNifty gains 0.75%
On NSE on 9 Nov, Muthoot Finance rose 2.19% to ₹2,917.60, Manappuram 0.23% to ₹323.75 and Shriram Finance 0.52% to ₹965.00, while IIFL Finance slipped 0.44% to ₹627.00 and Bajaj Finance fell 1.56% to ₹1,064.85. The Nifty 50 rose 0.23% to 25,044.65 and Nifty Financial Services 0.75% to 27,384.90, with PSU banks up 3.73%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Moneycontrol linked the gold-lender gains to a rebound in gold prices; Muthoot Finance is back near ₹2,900 after its 52-week low on 2 Nov.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy 9 Nov](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_09112026.csv)

### FIIs buy ₹7,212 crore, DIIs sell ₹7,173 crore on Monday
NSE's provisional data show FIIs net buyers of ₹7,212.22 crore and DIIs net sellers of ₹7,172.53 crore on 9 Nov. The rupee ended its winning run, closing 5 paise firmer at 93.93 per dollar according to The Hindu.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: strong foreign buying supported financials going into results week, the listed peer set for the proposed IPO.
Source: [NSE FII/DII](https://www.nseindia.com/reports/fii-dii)

### Spot gold near $4,128 after a 1% Monday gain; Brent slides on Iran comments
Reuters reported spot gold down 0.30% at $4,128.48 an ounce at 00:24 GMT on Tuesday, after rising more than 1% on Monday, with traders putting an 84% chance on a Fed rate rise in December ahead of today's US CPI. Reuters said Brent lost more than $7 a barrel after Monday's settlement, to its lowest since late August, after President Trump said he would hold off on new strikes on Iran.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: dollar gold is above Friday's level while IBJA's latest published rate is still from 6 Nov; lower oil prices ease inflation pressure.
Source: [Reuters via KLSE Screener](https://www.klsescreener.com/v2/news/view/1824271/gold-dips-ahead-of-us-inflation-data)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI cancels the registration of Gandhinagar Leasing and Finance
RBI said on 9 Nov it had cancelled the Certificate of Registration of the Ahmedabad-based NBFC on 29 Oct 2026 under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act. No new RBI notification since 5 Nov, and nothing new from SEBI, IBBI or NHB for NBFCs. Details in today's regulation report.
Source: [RBI press release](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63949)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No significant developments today. Manappuram's Q2 call is on 12 Nov.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Satya Micro Capital plans to sell its housing finance arm for ₹150–200 crore
Satya Micro Capital's MD told ET the NBFC-MFI has shortlisted three of seven or eight suitors for Satya Micro Housing Finance, which has a ₹260 crore loan book, and wants to close within a month. ET says the lender must repay about ₹175 crore by end-December, and its AUM fell below ₹2,000 crore by June from ₹6,000 crore in April 2024.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: an asset sale to meet repayments points to continued funding strain at weaker microfinance lenders, the segment where Muthoot Fincorp's subsidiary Muthoot Microfin operates.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/satya-micro-capital-to-sell-its-housing-finance-arm-to-address-liquidity-crunch/articleshow/135684200.cms)

### Veritas Finance gets SEBI's observations on its IPO
SEBI's processing-status list published on 9 Nov shows it issued observations on Veritas Finance's draft prospectus on 19 Oct, Moneycontrol reports. The Chennai-based NBFC plans a ₹900 crore fresh issue plus an offer for sale of up to 1.28 crore shares.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: another NBFC IPO is cleared to launch, adding to the pipeline that Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore issue would join.
Source: [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/norwest-venture-partners-and-kedaara-capital-backed-veritas-finance-ipo-gets-sebi-nod-14075645.html)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

No significant developments today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

No significant developments today.

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loan sector

### Gold lenders rally with gold on Monday; MCX December gold up 1.26% by late morning
Moneycontrol reported Muthoot Finance up 3% at ₹2,938.50 at 11:45 am on 9 Nov, with MCX December gold up ₹1,801 (1.26%) to ₹1,44,353 per 10g. By the close the gains had narrowed, with Muthoot Finance up 2.19% and Manappuram up 0.23% on NSE's bhavcopy.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: gold-lender shares continue to track gold prices day to day; AGLOC's per-gram ceiling is unchanged for 10 Nov.
Source: [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/muthoot-finance-manappuram-shares-gain-up-to-3-as-gold-prices-rebound-14075180.html)

### Three things now shaping gold-lender capital: IIFL's raise, CII's risk-weight ask, and AGLOC's flat ceiling
IIFL is set to raise over ₹6,200 crore in fresh equity, CII is asking the government to review the 100% risk weight on gold loans, and AGLOC's 85% ceiling is unchanged at ₹11,013/g for 10 Nov. The first two are about how much capital each rupee of gold loan uses; the third is about how much each gram can carry.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: competition is most direct in loans below ₹2.5 lakh, where the 85% LTV tier applies.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/blackstone-set-to-acquire-15-of-iifl-for-rs-5000-crore/articleshow/135691311.cms)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Tuesday, 10 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

One RBI enforcement item (a registration cancellation) and no new circular for NBFCs. Today is an exchange holiday.

### RBI cancels the Certificate of Registration of Gandhinagar Leasing and Finance Ltd
RBI said on 9 Nov that it cancelled the Certificate of Registration (CoR No. 01.00279, dated 8 Dec 1998) of the Ahmedabad-based NBFC on 29 Oct 2026, under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act. The company can no longer carry on the business of a non-banking financial institution.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none directly; the release covers a small Gujarat NBFC and gives no reason for the cancellation.
Reference: Press Release 2026-2027/1471 · Addressed to: Gandhinagar Leasing and Finance Ltd (public notice) · Issued: 9 Nov 2026 · Effective: 29 Oct 2026
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63949)

### CII asks for a review of the 100% risk weight on gold loans (industry proposal, not a rule)
CNBC-TV18 reports that CII's reform agenda to the Finance Ministry asks for a review of the 100% risk weight on secured gold loans, easier ECB conditions for NBFCs, and lighter governance and dividend rules for Upper Layer NBFCs. Nothing has been issued by RBI or the government.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no change today; a lower risk weight on gold loans, if adopted, would raise the capital ratio of gold lenders such as Muthoot Fincorp for the same loan book.
Reference: industry proposal (no circular) · Addressed to: Ministry of Finance · Issued: 9 Nov 2026 (press report)
Source: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/economy/cii-recommends-regulatory-relaxations-nbfcs-reform-agenda-to-finance-ministry20030393-20030393.htm)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 9–10 Nov
RBI's notifications feed still ends with the 5 Nov Master Directions on cyber resilience for non-bank payment system operators. Its 9 Nov press releases are the CoR cancellation above plus routine items (G-sec and SDL auctions, a VRR result, money-market operations and an Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank board supersession extension). SEBI's feed has nothing after 6 Nov, IBBI's site still shows a last update of 31 Oct, and NHB's notifications page lists no notice dated after 4 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none from the regulators today. The live items are still the 14 Nov Reg 52 results, the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment window.
Source: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx)

---

cards.title: Blackstone set to take 15% of IIFL Finance for about ₹5,000 crore
cards.summary: ET reports that Blackstone will invest around ₹5,000 crore for 15% of IIFL Finance, with promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman adding ₹1,200 crore, taking the total infusion to a little over ₹6,200 crore. ET says the money would lift IIFL's capital adequacy by about 5 percentage points to 28% and could cut its borrowing costs by 100–150 bps through a better rating; Moneycontrol reported the board meets on 10 Nov to weigh the proposals.
cards.impact: IIFL Finance is a listed gold-loan competitor, and a better-capitalised IIFL with lower funding costs could compete more strongly on gold-loan pricing; the deal is also a fresh private-equity valuation reference for gold-focused NBFCs ahead of Muthoot Fincorp's proposed IPO.

cards.title: CII asks the Finance Ministry to review the 100% risk weight on secured gold loans
cards.summary: CNBC-TV18 reports that CII's reform agenda asks for a review of the 100% risk weight on secured gold loans, easier ECB conditions for NBFCs, and more access to long-term money from HNIs, pension funds and insurers. It also asks the government to look at the tax gap between banks and NBFCs.
cards.impact: this is an industry proposal, not a rule change; a lower risk weight on gold loans, if adopted, would reduce the capital held against gold-loan books such as Muthoot Fincorp's.

cards.title: Update: no allotment notice yet for Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs, and today's exchange holiday rules out a 10 Nov listing
cards.summary: NSE's holiday list confirms 10 Nov as a trading holiday, so the listing date carried earlier can't hold. Chittorgarh's allotment page this morning still says allotment status isn't available, and no revised listing date has been published.
cards.impact: the deemed date of allotment and a revised listing date are still awaited; the company's listed-debt Q2 results fall due by 14 Nov.

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin flat on Monday at ₹159.73
cards.summary: Muthoot Fincorp's microfinance subsidiary closed at ₹159.73 on NSE on 9 Nov, up ₹0.06 from the Muhurat close, holding Sunday's 3.74% gain. It traded 3,59,779 shares.
cards.impact: the listed subsidiary held its Muhurat-session gain in a full session.

cards.title: Muthoot Finance up 2.19% as gold rebounds; FinNifty gains 0.75%
cards.summary: On NSE on 9 Nov, Muthoot Finance rose 2.19% to ₹2,917.60, Manappuram 0.23% to ₹323.75 and Shriram Finance 0.52% to ₹965.00, while IIFL Finance slipped 0.44% to ₹627.00 and Bajaj Finance fell 1.56% to ₹1,064.85. The Nifty 50 rose 0.23% to 25,044.65 and Nifty Financial Services 0.75% to 27,384.90, with PSU banks up 3.73%.
cards.impact: Moneycontrol linked the gold-lender gains to a rebound in gold prices; Muthoot Finance is back near ₹2,900 after its 52-week low on 2 Nov.

cards.title: FIIs buy ₹7,212 crore, DIIs sell ₹7,173 crore on Monday
cards.summary: NSE's provisional data show FIIs net buyers of ₹7,212.22 crore and DIIs net sellers of ₹7,172.53 crore on 9 Nov. The rupee ended its winning run, closing 5 paise firmer at 93.93 per dollar according to The Hindu. Source: NSE FII/DII
cards.impact: strong foreign buying supported financials going into results week, the listed peer set for the proposed IPO.

cards.title: Spot gold near $4,128 after a 1% Monday gain; Brent slides on Iran comments
cards.summary: Reuters reported spot gold down 0.30% at $4,128.48 an ounce at 00:24 GMT on Tuesday, after rising more than 1% on Monday, with traders putting an 84% chance on a Fed rate rise in December ahead of today's US CPI. Reuters said Brent lost more than $7 a barrel after Monday's settlement, to its lowest since late August, after President Trump said he would hold off on new strikes on Iran.
cards.impact: dollar gold is above Friday's level while IBJA's latest published rate is still from 6 Nov; lower oil prices ease inflation pressure.

cards.title: RBI cancels the registration of Gandhinagar Leasing and Finance
cards.summary: RBI said on 9 Nov it had cancelled the Certificate of Registration of the Ahmedabad-based NBFC on 29 Oct 2026 under Section 45-IA(6) of the RBI Act. No new RBI notification since 5 Nov, and nothing new from SEBI, IBBI or NHB for NBFCs.

cards.title: Satya Micro Capital plans to sell its housing finance arm for ₹150–200 crore
cards.summary: Satya Micro Capital's MD told ET the NBFC-MFI has shortlisted three of seven or eight suitors for Satya Micro Housing Finance, which has a ₹260 crore loan book, and wants to close within a month. ET says the lender must repay about ₹175 crore by end-December, and its AUM fell below ₹2,000 crore by June from ₹6,000 crore in April 2024.
cards.impact: an asset sale to meet repayments points to continued funding strain at weaker microfinance lenders, the segment where Muthoot Fincorp's subsidiary Muthoot Microfin operates.

cards.title: Veritas Finance gets SEBI's observations on its IPO
cards.summary: SEBI's processing-status list published on 9 Nov shows it issued observations on Veritas Finance's draft prospectus on 19 Oct, Moneycontrol reports. The Chennai-based NBFC plans a ₹900 crore fresh issue plus an offer for sale of up to 1.28 crore shares.
cards.impact: another NBFC IPO is cleared to launch, adding to the pipeline that Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹3,000 crore issue would join.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loan sector
cards.title: Gold lenders rally with gold on Monday; MCX December gold up 1.26% by late morning
cards.summary: Moneycontrol reported Muthoot Finance up 3% at ₹2,938.50 at 11:45 am on 9 Nov, with MCX December gold up ₹1,801 (1.26%) to ₹1,44,353 per 10g. By the close the gains had narrowed, with Muthoot Finance up 2.19% and Manappuram up 0.23% on NSE's bhavcopy.
cards.impact: gold-lender shares continue to track gold prices day to day; AGLOC's per-gram ceiling is unchanged for 10 Nov.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Tuesday: Gold loan sector
cards.title: Three things now shaping gold-lender capital: IIFL's raise, CII's risk-weight ask, and AGLOC's flat ceiling
cards.summary: IIFL is set to raise over ₹6,200 crore in fresh equity, CII is asking the government to review the 100% risk weight on gold loans, and AGLOC's 85% ceiling is unchanged at ₹11,013/g for 10 Nov. The first two are about how much capital each rupee of gold loan uses; the third is about how much each gram can carry. Source: Economic Times
cards.impact: competition is most direct in loans below ₹2.5 lakh, where the 85% LTV tier applies.
